purpose: Explicit machine-readable register of concrete runtime gaps discovered during architecture audit. These are not production-complete until the authorized integration slice verifies them.

evidence: crates/execution/src/lib.rs: BasicAgentEngine::start_run and resume_run do not invoke ModelProvider
gaps.required_behavior: A Run must deterministically cross the AgentEngine -> ModelProvider boundary and preserve request/response identity.
gaps.note: Current execution code invokes the configured ModelProvider during resume_run and preserves a deterministic request_id.

evidence: crates/providers/src/lib.rs: HttpModelProvider owns reqwest client/base_url but execute returns a simulated response without an HTTP request
gaps.required_behavior: Provider transport must make a real bounded request through the adapter, normalize failures and remain testable with deterministic integration fixtures.
gaps.note: Current providers implementation performs an actual bounded reqwest POST; the old simulated-response evidence is historical.

evidence: crates/tools/src/lib.rs: BasicPolicyEngine::evaluate only checks that grant_id is non-empty when permissions are required
crates/tools/src/lib.rs: check_capability returns true for any non-empty capability
gaps.required_behavior: Authorization must validate an issued capability grant, its principal/scope, requested capability and expiry.
gaps.next_action: Audit the tools crate policy boundary so capability validation is enforced there, not only by the kernel issuer.
gaps.note: Kernel capability grants now support expiry validation, but crates/tools still contains a boundary-level policy implementation that does not validate grant scope/principal.

evidence: crates/memory/src/lib.rs: InMemoryContextManager stores all context in process memory
crates/memory/src/lib.rs: InMemoryMemoryStore stores all memory entries in process memory
gaps.required_behavior: Context and memory must have a persistence adapter and restart/recovery tests behind the existing storage contract.
gaps.next_action: Unify the public memory/context storage ports with the durable SQLite path and add restart tests for the crates/memory boundary.
gaps.note: ReactAgent has durable SQLite conversation memory, while crates/memory still exposes in-memory adapters.

evidence: crates/execution/src/lib.rs: BasicAgentEngine stores known runs in an in-memory Vec<RunId>
crates/execution/src/lib.rs: resume_run rejects a run not present in that Vec
gaps.required_behavior: Run ownership/recovery must derive from durable kernel state rather than a process-local registry.
gaps.note: Execution can recover runs from KernelRuntime instead of depending exclusively on the process-local registry; the local registry remains a cache.

verification_policy.close_only_after: A gap may be marked resolved only when current code, declared acceptance evidence, and restart/failure behavior all support the required behavior. Partial gaps remain open for their specific boundary.
verification_policy.production_complete_definition: Feature completion requires user reachability, contract connection, persistence where appropriate, security, observability, failure tolerance, tests and documentation.
